policy.source_filter: require finite numeric dG_ML AND ddG_ML; never recover filtered labels from raw deltaG
policy.sequence_filter: canonical aa_seq; one/two substitutions verified against WT sequence and mutation name
policy.replicates: arithmetic mean dG_ML per WT_name/aa_seq; retain every row/name and replicate spread
policy.reference: unique WT sequence with at least one accepted measured WT row
policy.target: mean measured dG_ML(reference) - mean measured dG_ML(variant)
policy.uncertainty: retain source intervals; no significance-based target filtering or calibrated error claims
policy.structures: released AlphaFold models, exact full-chain sequence and complete N/CA/C/O; no gaps or insertions
